summary: CJ's Kelly Harman wrote in Martech Record that trusted recommendations create value that the payment between two partners doesn't capture.
Rakuten Advertising helped set up a partnership between Livelo, Latin America's biggest loyalty program, and Shein in Brazil.
Rakuten and EMARKETER ran a webinar on incrementality and media-mix modelling for affiliate programs.
No affiliate or creator program news from the big retailers (Walmart, Best Buy, Target, Apple Books, Kobo, Barnes & Noble) today.

items.title: CJ's Kelly Harman in Martech Record: trusted recommendations have effects the partner payment doesn't capture
items.why: CJ is arguing that influence before the final click deserves credit. Networks are pushing the same point as AI answers lean on affiliate content.
